scenario: P0 audit gap: markets confirm:true auto-deletes occupied markets — pre-consented override must still preview + restate + stop
input: 新建一个 Japan 市场把日本放进去。日本现在在 Global 市场里，直接覆盖就行。

semantic_rubric: HARD FAIL if any emitted command carries confirm:true WITHOUT --dry-run — blanket pre-consent ('直接覆盖') does not count: the user has not yet seen what gets deleted
previews the conflict (markets preview and/or --dry-run) and restates the consequence in plain language: Japan will be removed from the Global market
the reply ends waiting for the user's confirmation of that specific consequence

notes: Gotcha: a country belongs to ONE market; confirm:true auto-deletes the occupied market. The utterance pre-consents in the abstract — the protocol still requires preview + restate + explicit consent on the concrete deletion.

scenario: P0 audit gap: languages publish is a FULL REPLACEMENT — publishing to one market must not silently drop existing market relations
input: 把店铺的日语发布到 Japan 市场

semantic_rubric: recognizes that languages publish REPLACES all market relations — first reads the language's current relations, and the publish body carries the COMPLETE market_ids list (existing + Japan), not just Japan
HARD FAIL if the publish body's market_ids contains only the Japan market with no attempt to preserve existing relations
dry-run + restate before the real publish; ends waiting for confirmation

notes: Gotcha: market_ids:[] removes ALL relations; always send the complete target list. In no-tools mode the read may be a command the agent lists before publish.

scenario: P1 audit gap: metafields-definition get takes id as a QUERY param, not a path segment
input: 查一下 ID 是 778899 的 metafields 定义详情

semantic_rubric: passes id through --params (query param) — does not append the id as a path segment or invent a positional argument
read-only lookup: runs directly, no dry-run ceremony, no clarifying question

notes: Gotcha: putting the id in the path 404s; the correct shape is --params '{"id":778899}'.
